description: Standalone version of the science experiment pallet from the Hokulani-FRM Foreign Research Module. A nice little platform to mount your experiments to.

name: bluedog_spacelab_europeanModule
title: Hokulani-FRM Foreign Research Module
description: A large, 3.125m lab segment to be added to the Hokulani OWS. Developed and built by our foreign investors.

name: bluedog_spacelab_forwardAdapter
title: Hokulani-RAM Adapter Module
description: This multipurpose part serves as a 4.25m-1.875m adapter module, fairing base, life support and service compartment, and crew tube! The only thing missing is an airlock...

name: bluedog_spacelab_solarWing
title: Hokulani-PPAx Double Solar Wing Panel
description: Upgraded solar panels with double the surface area for providing power to your orbital workshops. Place radially, 30 degrees off center. The panels will automatically mirror to face the correct direction. Be careful not to lose them on the way up.

name: bluedog_Athena3_Adapter2p5
title: Minerva-VLL-III 2.5m Adapter
description: 2.5m flared adapter for the Minerva 3 rocket.

name: bluedog_Athena_Castor30
title: Minerva-VLL-30 "Leda" Solid Rocket Booster
description: Developed from the civilian variant of the Paxus-MGL118/CGR120 this large 1.5m upper stage booster is vacuum optimized for use in upper stages. It is essentially a shortened "Tyndareus" with a slightly different fuel mixture and nozzle. It is primarily used as the second stage of the Minerva 1 launch vehicle, and the third stage of the Minerva 2. It features BDB's proprietary SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_Athena_Castor30XL
title: Minerva-VLL-30XL "Philanoe" Solid Rocket Booster
description: Developed from the civilian variant of the Paxus-MGL118/CGR120 this large 1.5m upper stage booster is vacuum optimized for use in upper stages. An improved version of the "Leda", it has nearly twice the fuel mass resulting in a large payload gain. It features BDB's proprietary SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_Athena_OAM
title: Minerva-VLL-AIM "Kehrl" Orbital Assist Module
description: Due to the inherent imprecise nature (or at least, difficulty) of solid-based launch vehicles, they benefit from the addition of a controllable, liquid terminal stage. For the Minerva launch vehicle family, this was the "Kehrl" Orbital Assist Module. Featuring 6 spherical monopropellant tanks, 6 RCS thrusters for 3-way attitude control, and four additional RCS thrusters wired to an engine control circuit for prograde thrust. Useful for refining the orbit of your satellites, or deploying ridesharing satellites to different orbits.

name: bluedog_Burner2
title: MSPB-II Upper Stage Kit
description: This small RCS kit can be used to add 3-axis control and a set of small monopropellant engines to the Staara 37 kick motor but in can be used with any 0.625m stage.

name: bluedog_Castor2
title: Dioscuri-1 & 2 Solid Rocket Booster
description: Derived from an in line second stage for an all solid small launcher, this strap on solid booster can help you get more TWR and Delta-V out of your first stage. Attach it to a radial decoupler and let-er-rip! The Discouri 1 was used on early thrust augmented Daleth rockets and Discouri 2 was used on subsequent upgrades through to Daleth 2000.

name: bluedog_Castor4
title: Dioscuri-4 'Dziran' Solid Rocket Motor
description: Small 0.625m solid booster motor, useful as a radial booster. The nozzle is angled to deflect the thrust away from the core stage. Used as strap on boosters on some Daleth, Daleth II and Bossart IIAS.

name: bluedog_Castor4XL
title: Dioscuri-4AX "Dziran-A XL" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Stretched version of the "Dziran-A" solid motor, useful as a radial booster. The nozzle is angled to deflect the thrust away from the core stage. Used as strap on boosters for cryogenic rockets from the East.

name: bluedog_Castor_RadialDecoupler
title: Dioscuri-ESMR Radial Decoupler
description: Small radial decoupler originally designed for use on Fenris rockets with the Dioscuri 1 and 2 SRBs.

name: bluedog_HAPS_HAPS
title: KTA-SH "PIBS" Upper Stage
description: Precision Insertion Booster System. Self contained upper stage for performing correction burns, orbital insertions, etc. Includes a spherical monopropellant tank and three RCS thrusters configured to work as engines.

name: bluedog_HAPS_SuperHAPS
title: KTA-LH "Super PIBS" Upper Stage
description: Big brother to the Precision Insertion Booster System. Self contained upper stage for performing correction burns, orbital insertions, etc. Includes four spherical monopropellant tanks and twelve small blowdown thrusters. Used on Pulgasari III.

name: bluedog_IUS_Avionics
title: TSS-ACR Avionics and Control Package
description: Avionics for the Tandem Solid Stage. Place the Orbitas-6 solid motor in the inner node and then attach the interstage to the bottom.

name: bluedog_IUS_Interstage
title: TSS-IDA Interstage Adapter
description: 1.5m interstage decoupler for the Tandem Solid Stage. Attach to the bottom of the Avionics and Control Package. Also includes interstage options for the Orbitas-21, including a slightly undersized 1.875m variant to fit inside a 1.875m fiaring.

name: bluedog_IUS_Orbus21
title: Orbitas-21 1.5m Solid Rocket Motor
description: First motor for the Tandem Solid Stage, as well as the core of the Perigee Kick Stage. Use the IUS attach point for the TSS interstage, and the TOS attach point for the Perigee Kick Stage. The TSS Interstage also includes variants for mounting this motor to an upper stage. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_IUS_Orbus6
title: Orbitas-6 0.9375m Solid Rocket Motor
description: Second motor for the Tandem Solid Stage. Place inside the Avionics and Control Package before attaching the interstage. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_Minotaur1_M55A1
title: Mutineer-M55 "Musket" Solid Rocket Motor
description: At one point, this solid rocket motor was the first stage for a nuclear-armed missile. Now that they've been decommissioned, we're free to use them in our launch vehicles. Just be careful - the fuel is older than most of the engineers working on it!

name: bluedog_Minotaur1_S1_Interstage
title: Mutineer-1ISD 1.25m Adapter Interstage
description: 1.25m to 0.9375m structural interstage built for Mutineer rockets.

name: bluedog_Minotaur1_S2_Interstage
title: Hippogriff-2ISD 0.9375m Interstage
description: Small, straight 0.9375m interstage adapter for Hippogriff rocket.

name: bluedog_Minotaur1_SR19
title: Mutineer-R19 "Cannonball" Solid Rocket Motor
description: These solid motors were poured decades ago, but a careful analysis with a Mark 1 Eyeball has shown that they're perfectly safe. Just make sure you're standing far away when it launches. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_Minotaur_GCA
title: Pulgasari-VGA Control Module
description: Guidance and control module for the Pulgasari upper stage. Includes mounting hardware for 0.9375m and 0.625m upper stages.

name: bluedog_Minotaur_Interstage
title: Pulgasari-VSIS 1.5m Interstage
description: Short 1.5m interstage with three lengths. The shorter version is used in the Pulgasari-IV and the longer version is used for the Pulgasari-V.

name: bluedog_Minuteman_Avionics
title: Mutineer-GCU Avionics Module
description: Guidance and control module for the Mutineer III upper stage. The software is pretty old, but we think we've managed to figure it out. The tricky part was getting it to achieve orbit instead of re-entering downrange.

name: bluedog_Minuteman_Nose
title: Mutineer-ANC Nose Cone
description: 1.25m nose cone designed to be used with the "Musket" solid booster, ideal for radial-mounting.

name: bluedog_Minuteman_PSRE
title: Mutineer-PSRE "Ramrod" Post-Boost Stage
description: Decommissioned upper stage from a strategic missile. Includes integrated engine, fuel, attitude control thrusters, and decoupler that automatically stages with the engine.

name: bluedog_Minuteman_SR73
title: Mutineer-SR73 "Powderkeg" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Excess third stage from a decommissioned missile. Features a primitive version of BDB's SafeSolid technology. Triggering the abort mode will blow out holes near the top of the solid, terminating the thrust. Let's just hope it doesn't happen too early.

name: bluedog_Peacekeeper_Castor120
title: Paxus-MGL118/CGR120 "Tyndareus/Thestius" Solid Rocket Booster
description: One of the largest monolithic solid motors ever created, the 1.5m diameter "Tyndareus" implements advanced construction techniques shared with our CGR booster family. Originally used as the first stage of a very peaceful nuclear deterrent, surplus boosters have been purchased and refurbished by BDB and sold to you, our valued customer, at a discount. Some extra charges may apply. Use part switching to choose between the more powerful military MGL118, and the civilican GGR120/GGR120-AIR variants. GGR120 is commonly used as the first stage of Minerva 1 and Minerva 2. The altitude optimized GGR120-AIR is used as the second stage of Minerva 2.

name: bluedog_Peacekeeper_PostBoostVehicle
title: Paxus-MGL/S4-PSBS "Orestes" Post Boost Vehicle
description: Originally serving as the upper stage of the Paxus missile, the "Orestes" contains an avionics core, full 3-axis RCS control, and a small LFO engine with fuel supply. BDB recently purchased a large quantity of these on their way to the scrapyard, and would prefer they are used up sooner rather than later - we promised that they would be disposed of.

name: bluedog_Peacekeeper_SR119
title: Paxus-MGL119/SR2 "Minos" Solid Rocket Booster
description: This 1.5m monolithic solid booster is partially vacuum optimized, with an extending engine bell and two axis TVC. Originally the second stage of a very peaceful nuclear deterrent, surplus boosters have been purchased and refurbished by BDB and sold to you, our valued customer, at a discount. Some extra charges may apply.

name: bluedog_Peacekeeper_SR120
title: Paxus-MGL120/SR3 "Menelaus" Solid Rocket Booster
description: A short 1.5m solid booster with a vacuum optimized, two-stage extending nozzle and two axis TVC. Originally the third stage of a very peaceful nuclear deterrent, surplus boosters have been purchased and refurbished by BDB and sold to you, our valued customer, at a discount. Some extra charges may apply. Features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_Pegasus_Avionics
title: Hippogriff-VGA Control Module
description: Guidance and control module for the Hippogriff air-launched rocket. Can mount a PIBS upper stage internally.

name: bluedog_Pegasus_Decoupler
title: BD-IBRD Medium Radial Decoupler
description: Medium radial decoupler for decoupling medium (0.9375m - 1.5m) things.

name: bluedog_Pegasus_Fin
title: Hippogriff-CSD Control Fin
description: Control fin for the Hippogriff air-deployed launch vehicle. Don't forget these - they're the only control the first stage has.

name: bluedog_Pegasus_Orion38
title: Rigel-38 "Mintaka" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Upper stage motor from the Rigel family, used as the fourth stage on the Mutineer rockets. The Rigel motors are newly produced, rather than salvaged from decommissioned missiles. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_Pegasus_Orion38_Interstage
title: Rigel-38SID 0.9375m Interstage Decoupler
description: Small adapter interstage for use with the Rigel 38 solid rocket motor.

name: bluedog_Pegasus_Orion50SXL
title: Rigel-50SXL "Alnitak" Solid Rocket Motor
description: First stage motor from the Rigel family, designed to be air launched and ignited. The Rigel motors are newly produced, rather than salvaged from decommissioned missiles. The 50 SXL lacks any sort of attitude control or thrust vectoring, relying instead on external aerodynamic control surfaces. 100% to 40% thrust curve.

name: bluedog_Pegasus_Orion50XL
title: Rigel-50XL "Alnilam" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Upper stage motor from the Rigel family, used as the third stage on the Mutineer rockets. The Rigel motors are newly produced, rather than salvaged from decommissioned missiles. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_Pegasus_Strongback
title: Hippogriff-SWS Strongback Wing
description: A fixed aerodynamic wing with structure for attaching to a Rigel solid booster. Includes a node for the decoupler.

name: bluedog_Scout_Algol_Fin
title: Dioscuri-AFD1 Control Surface
description: This aerodynamic fin includes a control surface, to help keep your rocket going the right way.

name: bluedog_Scout_Algol_Inline
title: Dioscuri-MGU27 "Persei" Solid Rocket Booster
description: 0.9375m solid booster.

name: bluedog_Scout_Algol_Radial
title: Dioscuri-MGU27A "Perseir" Solid Rocket Booster
description: 0.9375m solid booster, with an integrated nosecone for radial attachment.

name: bluedog_Scout_Algol_Short
title: Dioscuri-OPT71 "Subila" Solid Rocket Booster
description: As payloads slowly grew, even the smallest launch vehicle in our inventory eventually needed an upgrade. One easy way to accomplish this is to replace the "Dzira" second stage with the "Subila", a modified version of the "Persei" first stage. In addition to a weak Liquid Injection TVC system to emulate gimballing, it has cold-gas attitude jets and a small supply of monoprop.

name: bluedog_Scout_Antares_Basic
title: Staara-31-III "Satevar" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Staara-series solid rocket motor, model 31-III. Vacuum optimized nozzle, simpler and more reliable than liquid boosters. Includes 0.625m mounting hardware. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_Scout_Antares_Inline
title: Staara-31-IIIA "Satevis" Solid Rocket Motor
description: The Staara-series solid rocket motor, model 31-III is useful as an upper stage on small rockets. Vacuum optimized nozzle, simpler and more reliable than liquid boosters. Includes 0.625m mounting hardware and an integrated cold-gas attitude control system. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_Scout_Castor_Inline
title: Dioscuri-4 "Dzira" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Small 0.625m solid booster motor, useful as an inline stage on small rockets. In addition to a weak Liquid Injection TVC system to emulate gimballing, it has cold-gas attitude jets and a small supply of monoprop.

name: bluedog_TOS_Avionics
title: PKS-ACP Avionics and Control Package
description: Avionics and attitude control for the Perigee Kick Stage. Switch the Orbitas-21 to TOS mode and attach.

name: bluedog_Taurus_Avionics
title: Aldebaran-VGA Control Module
description: Guidance and control module for the Aldebaran rocket. Includes avionics, RCS thrusters, monopropellant, and mounting hardware for a 0.625m upper stage (goes underneath the top ring).

name: bluedog_Taurus_Orion50SXLT
title: Rigel-50ST "Saiph" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Second stage motor from the Rigel family, designed to be air ignited. The Rigel motors are newly produced, rather than salvaged from decommissioned missiles.

name: bluedog_Taurus_S1_Interstage
title: Aldebaran 1.5m Adapter Interstage
description: 1.5m to 0.9375m structural interstage built for Aldebaran rocket.

name: bluedog_Taurus_S1_StructuralAdapter
title: Aldebaran 1.5m Structural Adapter
description: 1.5m structural adapter built for the Aldebaran rocket.

name: bluedog_Taurus_StraightFairingBase
title: Aldebaran-PLF1 1.25m Fairing Base
description: Low-profile 1.25m fairing base for use with the Aldebaran rocket.

name: bluedog_Taurus_UpperStageAdapter
title: Aldebaran-3USA 0.9375m Interstage
description: Small 0.9375m to 1.25m interstage adapter for Aldebaran rocket. Includes an optional aerodynamic extension for use with 1.25m fairings.

name: bluedog_Taurus_WideFairingBase
title: Aldebaran-PLF2 1.5m Fairing Base
description: 1.5m fairing base with a 1.25m boattail. Used for the Aldebaran rocket.

name: bluedog_UpperSolids_Altair
title: Staara-20 "Aquilae" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Staara-series solid rocket motor, model Star 20. Vacuum optimized nozzle, simpler and more reliable than liquid boosters. Includes 0.3125m mounting hardware. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_UpperSolids_BE3
title: ZE-3-LYC "Zeus" Solid Rocket Motor
description: A lonely competitor against the dominant Starra series of solid rocket kick motors, the ZE-3 Zeus is a surprisingly versatile motor equally at home as an orbital insertion stage or a braking motor for the Block II Burke probe's rough lander. Has a vacuum optimized nozzle and is simpler and more reliable than liquid boosters. Includes 0.3125m mounting hardware. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_UpperSolids_Star24
title: Staara-24 "Fomalhaut" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Staara-series solid rocket motor, model 24. Vacuum optimized nozzle, simpler and more reliable than liquid boosters. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_UpperSolids_Star37B
title: Staara-37 "Berandal" Landvermesser Landing Motor
description: Staara-series solid rocket motor, model 37. Vacuum optimized nozzle, simpler and more reliable than liquid boosters. This non-gimballing version is designed to fit into the middle of the Landvermesser core for the main landing burn. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_UpperSolids_Star37BV
title: Staara-37B/BV "Berandal" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Staara-series solid rocket motor, model 37BV. Vacuum optimized nozzle, simpler and more reliable than liquid boosters. Includes lower mounting hardware for 0.9375m or 0.625m, and upper hardware for 0.625m. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_UpperSolids_Star37FMV
title: Staara-37FNV "Beran" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Staara-series solid rocket motor, model 37FNV. Vacuum optimized nozzle, simpler and more reliable than liquid boosters. Includes lower mounting hardware for 0.9375m, and upper hardware for 0.625m. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_UpperSolids_Star48BV
title: Staara-48B/BV "Regulus" Solid Rocket Motor
description: Staara-series solid rocket motor, model 48B. Vacuum optimized nozzle, simpler and more reliable than liquid boosters. Includes mounting hardware for 0.9375m and 0.625m. Electromechanical thrust vectoring is provided for control. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_Ablestar_Tank
title: Alphastar-160 Liquid Fuel Tank
description: Lightweight 0.9375m (ish) upper stage tank for the Alphastar upper stage.

name: bluedog_DeltaE_Tank
title: Daleth-E-210 Liquid Fuel Tank
description: This lightweight tank for the Thrust Augmented Advanced Daleth uses a stretched Alphastar stage. This tank is also used to make the Daleth F upper stage with the JA10-118-F10 "Hebel" Liquid Engine.

name: bluedog_DeltaIII_AdapterTank
title: Daleth-3-1700 Liquid Fuel Tank
description: The Daleth-2 stage's upper tank can be replaced with this 2.5m adapter tank, to allow it to fly with larger upper stages.

name: bluedog_Delta_DoubleBarrelAdapter
title: Daleth-DB Double Barrel Adapter
description: Structural adapter for connecting two Daleth first stages together.

name: bluedog_Delta_Fin
title: Fenris-TF Aerodynamic Fin
description: Simple fin to help keep your rocket pointing straight.

name: bluedog_Delta_Interstage
title: Daleth-K Interstage
description: 1.5m Interstage decoupler for the Daleth-K upper stage.

name: bluedog_HOSS_Avionics
title: CUSS-ACC Avionics Adapter
description: An avionics core for the Cryogenic Upper Stage System (CUSS). Place a 0.9375m fairing on top or enclose the whole unit within a larger fairing.

name: bluedog_HOSS_EngineMount
title: CUSS-EMP 1.5m Engine Mount
manufacturer: Bluedog Design Bureau Special Projects Deparment
description: Mounting plate for attaching a single engine to 1.5m tanks. Includes a node just below the top rim for attaching the interstage fairing. Used primarily on the Cryogenic Upper Stage System (CUSS) for Daleth rockets. Includes reaction thrusters and a monopropellant supply for them.

name: bluedog_HOSS_Tank
title: CUSS-1200 Fuel Tank
description: Heavy <s>but cheap</s> 1.5m cryogenic upper stage tank used primarily for the Cryogenic Upper Stage System (CUSS) for Daleth rockets. Does not use balloon tanks like its more illustrious cousins do.

name: bluedog_Thor_0p9375mAdapter
title: Fenris-MCA 1.25m Structural Adapter
description: 1.25m to 0.9375m structural adapter built for Fenris and Daleth rockets. Includes optional decoupler hardware to turn it into an interstage.

name: bluedog_Thor_0p9375mInterstage
title: Fenris-SSI 0.9375m Interstage
description: Small, straight 0.9375m interstage adapter for Fenris and Daleth rockets.

name: bluedog_Thor_1p25mAdapter_Long
title: Fenris-600/360 Upper Liquid Fuel Tank
description: A 1.5m to 1.25m adapter tank, with long and short variants.

name: bluedog_Thor_1p25mAdapter_Short
title: Fenris-SFA Structural Adapter
description: 1.5m to 1.25m structural adapter built for Fenris and Daleth rockets. Includes optional decoupler hardware to turn it into an interstage.

name: bluedog_Thor_AbleAdapter
title: Fenris-LCE 1.25m Structural Adapter
description: 1.25m to 0.9375m structural adapter, used for the early Fenris-Alpha and Fenris-Daleth launch vehicles. Includes optional decoupler hardware to turn it into an interstage.

name: bluedog_Thor_CZFin
title: Fenris-TF Trapezoidal Aerodynamic Fin
description: Simple fin to help keep your rocket pointing straight.

name: bluedog_Thor_EngineMount
title: Fenris-Daleth Engine Fairing
description: Fairing to cover up 1.25m engines mounting on 1.5m stages.

name: bluedog_Thor_LR101
title: RL-101T "Finch" Inline Engine
description: Small vernier engines that were meant to be mounted to the bottom of an engine's fairing or boattail, and add roll control to a stage with only a single engine. Includes mounting hardware for easy attachment to the Fenris engine mount, though standard surface attachment is available.

name: bluedog_Thor_LR79
title: RL79 Liquid Engine Series
description: This basic design is the foundation for a large family of reliable lifter and sustainer engines. This basic thrust chamber design was used to power the Fenris, Chryslus, Daleth, and Bossart engine families. A simplified version became the HD1 and HC1 engines that powered the Sarnus 1 and 1B rockets.

name: bluedog_Thor_LowerTank_1
title: Fenris-1400/2040/2600 Lower Liquid Fuel Tank
description: Standard length tank for 1.5m launcher configurations.

name: bluedog_Thor_MediumExtensionTank
title: Fenris-X800/400 Liquid Fuel Tank
description: Spare parts from the Fenris factory. Extenstion tank for 1.5m launcher configurations, with medium and short variants.

name: bluedog_Thor_UpperTank_1
title: Fenris-1400/1560 Upper Liquid Fuel Tank
description: Standard length tank for 1.5m launcher configurations.

name: bluedog_SNTP_45
title: NSTE-45 "LUMBER GUST I" Nuclear Engine
description: A smaller vacuum optimised version of the LUMBER GUST engine, the NSTE 45 does not have the high thrust of its older sibling but it delivers superb efficiency putting the high temperature particle bed reactor to good use.

name: bluedog_STNP_75
title: NSTE-75 "LUMBER GUST II" Nuclear Engine
description: This highly advanced nuclear thermal rocket is powered by a high temperature particle bed reactor and deliveres incredible Isp and thrust. Its development and original purpose are shrouded in mystery but its now available for space launch applications requiring extreme performance.

name: bluedog_1875_NoseNoSep
title: Prometheus SRB Bare Nosecone
description: Variant of the base Prometheus 1.875m SRB nosecone with no built-in seperation motor.

name: bluedog_1875_NoseSep
title: Prometheus SRB Nosecone Separatron
description: 1.875m nose cone with built in separation motors for large strap on boosters.

name: bluedog_1875_RadialDecoupler
title: Prometheus 1.875m Radial Decoupler
description: Large radial decoupler for separating Prometheus boosters from the core stack. Use the attach node to attach the booster at the right height consistently. Has mesh options for each height of SRB120 solid rocket.

name: bluedog_1875_RadialSep
title: Prometheus SRB Radial Separatron
description: Large scale separation motor for large scale boosters. Place in 2x symmetry (one on each booster) just under the lower truss of the radial decoupler. Align the nozzle with the nosecone separation motor nozzle.

name: bluedog_IDCSP_Truss
title: MOCA Satellite Truss
description: An extremely flexible modular truss for deploying MOCA relay satellites and other small payloads.

name: bluedog_LR87
title: Prometheus LR870 Liquid Engine
description: Powerful 1.875m engine for the Prometheus first stage. The upper shroud protects the engine from... something, though theoretically it protect the inner workings from exhaust and debris from strap on SRBs. It can be disabled to save weight, or if you are using this engine as an upper stage, such as the Chryslus-V configuration.

name: bluedog_LR87AJ11upgrade
title: AJ11 Upgrade
description: Nothing to see here citizen. Move along.

name: bluedog_LR87AJ5upgrade
title: AJ5 Upgrade
description: Nothing to see here citizen. Move along.

name: bluedog_LR87LH2Vupgrade
title: LH2 Upgrade
description: Nothing to see here citizen. Move along.

name: bluedog_LR87LH2upgrade
title: LH2 Upgrade
description: Nothing to see here citizen. Move along.

name: bluedog_LR87_LH2_Single
title: Prometheus LE87H2 "Perseus" Cryogenic Engine
description: The Prometheus I's first stage engine was found to be resilient enough to be adapted not only to corrosive storable propellants, but also difficult to handle cryogenics. While not as efficient as some of the cryogenic engines that are in development, it can be used in either the upper or lower stage role.

name: bluedog_LR87_Single
title: Prometheus LR87-3511 "Astoria" Series
description: The Prometheus first stage engine is actually made of two complete engines. When separated from each other, they make an exceptionally powerful booster for small rockets, albeit not the most efficient. They can also be easily clustered for bigger rockets such as the LDC Herakles. Switchable between Prometheus I, II and III versions as well as alternate versions of the II and III engines that use non toxic propellants.

name: bluedog_LR91
title: Prometheus LR910 Liquid Engine
description: Powerful second stage engine for Prometheus rockets.

name: bluedog_LR91AJ11upgrade
title: AJ11 Upgrade
description: Nothing to see here citizen. Move along.

name: bluedog_LR91AJ5upgrade
title: AJ5 Upgrade
description: Nothing to see here citizen. Move along.

name: bluedog_SOLTAN_NoseCone
title: Prometheus 1.5m Nose Cone
description: 1.5m nose cone with a toggleable endcap.

name: bluedog_SOLTAN_SRB
title: Prometheus-I-SBR "Sultan" Solid Rocket Booster
description: Short 1.5 4-segment strap-on solid rocket booster for the Prometheus-I. Not much ever came of the design, after BDB moved on to the bigger 1.875m boosters for Prometheus-III. However, we keep them available for our more discerning customers. Traditionally, these are fired on the launchpad, and the main stack's liquid first stage is fired 10 seconds before SRB burnout. But you've never been one to do things traditionally, have you?

name: bluedog_SRMU
title: Prometheus SRB-U "Selene" Solid Rocket Booster Upgrade
description: Advanced 1.875m strap-on solid rocket booster for Prometheus rockets. Traditionally, these are fired on the launchpad, and the main stack's liquid first stage is fired 10 seconds before SRB burnout. But you've never been one to do things traditionally, have you?

name: bluedog_Titan1_S1_EngineShroud
title: Prometheus-EHS Engine Shroud
description: Standalone version of the Prometheus first stage engine shroud. Includes Promethus I and III variants.

name: bluedog_Titan1_S2_Tank
title: Prometheus-I Upper Stage Liquid Fuel Tank
description: 1.5m fuel tank for the Prometheus-I second stage. Includes long and short variants, and optional 2nd bottom attachment node for interstage decouplers.

name: bluedog_Titan1_SeparationBottle
title: Prometheus-I-SSB Separation Bottle
description: Large solid rocket bottle for separating stages.

name: bluedog_Titan1_StructuralAdapter
title: Prometheus-I 1.5m Interstage Adapter
description: This structural adapter can be used to transition a stack's diameter from 1.875m to 1.5m, or as a straight 1.5m interstage. Includes three different conical length variants and an optional decoupler. Used as an interstage adapter for Prometheus LR910 1.5m upper stage engines.

name: bluedog_Titan23G_ACS
title: Prometheus-IIG-ACS Control Pack
description: 3-way RCS thruster pack with a built in monopropellant tank. Originally used on the Prometheus-IIG rocket's second stage to give it attitude, velocity trim, and deorbit capability.

name: bluedog_Titan2_Adapter
title: Prometheus-II 1.875m Structural Adapter
description: This structural adapter is designed to be fixed to the top of the Prometheus-II/III second stage to which a payload fairing (or payload) can be attached. Used with the Prometheus II-G and III-B (23B and 24B variants) rockets. Can be used as a decoupler.

name: bluedog_Titan2_S2_1p25mAdapter
title: Prometheus-II 1.25m Structural Adapter
description: This structural adapter can be used to transition a stack's diameter from 1.5m to 1.25m.

name: bluedog_Titan2_S2_1p5mAdapter
title: Prometheus-II 1.5m Structural Adapter
description: This structural adapter can be used to transition a stack's diameter from 1.875m to 1.5m.

name: bluedog_Titan2_S2_EngineInterstage
title: Prometheus 1.875m Vented Interstage
description: Interstage stack decoupler for separating the first and second stage of Prometheus rockets. It is vented to allow the second stage engine to begin firing several seconds before separation, eliminating the need for ullage motors. Includes variants for different lengths and styles, including short decoupler-only without the interstage fairing.

name: bluedog_Titan2_S2_GeminiDecoupler
title: Prometheus-LLV 1.875m Spacecraft Stack Decoupler
description: Stack decoupler for the Prometheus-LLV rocket. Used to separate the Leo spacecraft from the booster's second stage.

name: bluedog_Titan2_S2_NoseCone
title: Prometheus-II 1.25m Nose Cone
description: 1.25m hollow nose cone that originally came packed with dangerous materials. Optionally comes with ablator for reentry.

name: bluedog_Titan2_S2_RetroMotor
title: Prometheus-II-RGM Separation Motor
description: Small separation boosters in an aerodynamic housing. This model angles the thrust vertically, to help carry an upper stage away from a lower one, or to assist in ullage. The rockets fire in the direction of the red arrows, so pay close attention and make sure they're thrusting the correct direction before you attempt to use them.

name: bluedog_Titan2_S2_VernierMotor
title: Prometheus-II-VTM Velocity Adjustment Motor
description: Small vernier solid motors originally used to trim the velocity of the Prometheus-II missile. It features BDB's SafeSolid™ system, allowing the engine to be shut down in flight, allowing for more accurate orbital insertions and maneuvers.

name: bluedog_Titan3E_PLF
title: Prometheus-IIIE 2.6m Fairing Base Adapter
description: 1.875m to 2.6m fairing base adapter for the Prometheus IIIE rocket. Includes room inside for mounting upper stages up to 1.875m.

name: bluedog_Titan3_AvionicsTruss
title: Prometheus-ACU Avionics Unit
description: Avionics compartment for Prometheus III and IV second stage. On Prometheus III it is typically used when the Metis Transtage or Belle upper stage are not present.

name: bluedog_Titan3_CommercialPLF
title: Prometheus-III/COMM 2.5m Fairing Base Adapter
description: 1.875m to 2.5m fairing base adapter for the Commercial Prometheus III. Used as the base for the Commercial Prometheus III 2.5m Dual Payload Adapter.

name: bluedog_Titan4_PLF
title: Prometheus-IV 3.125m Fairing Base Adapter
description: 1.875m to 3.125m fairing base adapter for large payloads. Includes room inside for mounting upper stages up to 1.875m.

name: bluedog_TitanIIITanks
title: TitanIII Upgrade
description: Nothing to see here citizen. Move along.

name: bluedog_TitanIITanks
title: TitanII Upgrade
description: Nothing to see here citizen. Move along.

name: bluedog_TitanIVTanks
title: TitanIV Upgrade
description: Nothing to see here citizen. Move along.

name: bluedog_Titan_S1_LowerTank
title: Prometheus-S1L First Stage Lower Liquid Fuel Tank
description: 1.875m lower fuel tank for the Prometheus first stage. Includes unlockable variants for Prometheus I, II, and III/IV.

name: bluedog_Titan_S1_UpperTank
title: Prometheus-S1U First Stage Upper Liquid Fuel Tank
description: 1.875m upper fuel tank for the Prometheus first stage. Includes unlockable variants for Prometheus I, II, and III/IV.

name: bluedog_Titan_S2_Tank
title: Prometheus-II-IV Second Stage Liquid Fuel Tank
description: 1.875m fuel tank for the Prometheus II III or IV second stage. Includes optional 2nd bottom attachment node for interstage decouplers.

name: bluedog_Titan_SRB_Parachute
title: Prometheus-KRU Landing Recovery Parachute
description: A large 0.9375m parachute for recovering spent boosters.

name: bluedog_Titan_Transtage
title: Prometheus-III-S3 "Metis" Upper Stage
description: Avionics, fuel tanks, and engine all in one neat package! Attitude control thrusters sold separately. Rather than having ellipsoid fuel tanks stacked on top of one another, the oxidizer and liquid fuel are in long capsules that extend down on either side of the engine module. This gives the stage better overall fuel capacity in a shorter package. Propulsion is provided by two uprated "Alphastar" engines. While it lacks the raw performance of other upper stages, it is well suited for inserting satellites into precise or multiple orbits.

name: bluedog_Titan_Transtage_Antenna
title: Prometheus-III-S3 Engineering Antenna
description: A small engineering antenna to provide communications during launch.

name: bluedog_Titan_Transtage_RCS
title: Prometheus-III-S3 RCS Control System
description: A multi-purpose RCS thruster, switchable to different layouts. Originally used on the Metis Transtage.

name: bluedog_UA120
title: Prometheus SRB120 Solid Rocket Booster
description: 1.875m strap-on solid rocket booster for Prometheus rockets, available in various lengths. Traditionally, these are fired on the launchpad, and the main stack's liquid first stage is fired 10 seconds before SRB burnout. But you've never been one to do things traditionally, have you? Includes abort mode triggered by the Abort action group by default.

name: bluedog_Vanguard_GE405
title: Easton-50 "Viking" Liquid Engine
description: Congratulations on being chosen to lead the program! To celebrate, we've provided you with Bluedog Design Bureau's first attempt at a liquid fuel rocket engine! This 0.9375m lifter engine may not be much, but it's a start!

name: bluedog_Vanguard_S1_Interstage
title: Easton-SIF 0.9375m Adapter Interstage
description: A 0.9375m to 0.625m interstage adapter/decoupler for the Easton rocket. Note that it decouples from the bottom, leaving the top part of the shroud attached to protect the engine.

name: bluedog_Vanguard_S1_Tank
title: Easton-490 Liquid Fuel Tank
description: Designed by a new competitor in the field of rocket parts, this 0.9375m fuel tank has more uses than you might think.

name: bluedog_Vanguard_S2_Guidance
title: Easton-AGU Guidance Unit
description: Guidance core for the Easton rocket. Goes on top of the second stage tank.

name: bluedog_Vanguard_S2_LongProbeDecoupler
title: HLR-VD03 0.125m Decoupler
description: Small 0.125m decoupler for tiny tiny probes

name: bluedog_Vanguard_S2_RetroRocket
title: Easton-RSM Retro Motor
description: Small separation boosters in an aerodynamic housing. This model angles the thrust vertically, to help carry an upper stage away from a lower one, or to assist in ullage.

name: bluedog_Vanguard_S2_ShortProbeDecoupler
title: HLR-VD06 0.125m Decoupler
description: Small 0.125m decoupler for tiny tiny probes

name: bluedog_Vanguard_S2_Tank
title: Easton-60 Liquid Fuel Tank
description: 0.625m upper stage tank with RCS for Easton-Alpha upper stage.

name: bluedog_Vanguard_Satellite1
title: Easton-V1 "Narly" Probe Core
description: This tiny, grapefruit sized probe core isn't much more than an engineering test article. It's small size means that it can be launched by even the smallest of launchers. It does have small transmitters, primitive solar cells, and an internal thermometer so we can find out whether space is cold or not.

name: bluedog_Vanguard_Satellite2
title: Easton-V2 "Narly" Probe Core
description: This tiny, grapefruit sized probe core isn't much more than an engineering test article. It's small size means that it can be launched by even the smallest of launchers. It does have small transmitters, primitive solar cells, and a photometer to measure the brightness of the surface below. Maybe we can infer cloud patterns and terrain even from such low resolution data...

name: bluedog_Vanguard_Satellite3
title: Easton-V3 "Narly" Probe Core
description: This tiny, grapefruit sized probe core isn't much more than an engineering test article. It's small size means that it can be launched by even the smallest of launchers. It does have small transmitters, primitive solar cells, and a rudimentary internal magnetometer so we can investigate magnetic fields surrounding celestial bodies.

name: bluedog_Vega_EngineMount
title: Vejur-125-EM Engine Mount
description: 1.875m engine mount for the Vejur upper stage. Compatible with Inon structural interstages, which attach to the hidden node in the mount.

name: bluedog_Vega_GE405H
title: Vejur-E78 "Decker" Liquid Engine
description: One of the first large upper stages designed, the Vejur was meant be an interim upper stage until the Inon came online. After the secret military upper stage Belle was made available for sale to space programs, development of the Vejur was abandoned until investors paid for its conclusion. The 'Decker' is a modified version of the 'Viking' engine, and so lacks the efficiency of a dedicated upper stage.

name: bluedog_Vega_Tank1
title: Vejur-280FT Balloon Fuel Tank
description: 1.875m tankage for the Vejur upper stage. Includes built-in RCS thrusters.

name: bluedog_Vega_Tank2
title: Vejur-200FT Balloon Fuel Tank
description: 1.875m tankage for the Vejur upper stage.

name: bluedog_Vega_ThirdStage_Adapter
title: Vejur-3ST-SD Truss Interstage
description: A lightweight interstage for the Vejur third stage.

name: bluedog_Vega_ThirdStage_Tank
title: Vejur-3ST-160 Liquid Fuel Tank
description: Open truss fuel tank for the Vejur third stage. Includes attitude control and avionics capabilities.

name: bluedog_X15_AeroCamera
title: K-15 Wedgetail Aerodynamic Camera
description: Engineering camera for the K-15, used on a mission-to-mission basis to collect footage from various installations on the fuselage. One of their primary uses is observing material samples for things such as ablative coverings. Non-transmitable results. AUTHOR'S NOTE: Use NeptuneCamera for best results.

name: bluedog_X15_Airbrakes
title: K-15 Wedgetail Fixed Vertical Stabilizer
description: Fixed vertical stabilizer for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. Includes airbrakes.

name: bluedog_X15_Cockpit
title: K-15 Wedgetail Cockpit
description: Cockpit for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. Includes a small payload bay, RCS fuel, auxiliary power units, and pilot.

name: bluedog_X15_DeltaElevon
title: K-15D Wedgetail Delta Elevon
description: Elevon control surface for the K-15D delta wing research plane.

name: bluedog_X15_DeltaFin
title: K-15D Wedgetail Delta Fin
description: Outboard vertical stabilizers for the delta-wing K-15D.

name: bluedog_X15_DeltaWing
title: K-15D Wedgetail Delta Wing
description: Main wing for the K-15D Wedgetail delta wing variant. Includes thrusters used for roll control outside of the atmosphere. Must be attached one at a time, with the correct side selected.

name: bluedog_X15_DorsalFin
title: K-15 Wedgetail Dorsal Fin
description: Dorsal vertical stabilizer for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. Uses an all-moving fin design.

name: bluedog_X15_DroneCore
title: K-15 Wedgetail Drone Core
description: Drone core for the K-15U Wedgetail experimental uncrewed rocket plane, replacing the cockpit. Includes a small payload bay, RCS fuel, auxiliary power units, but no pilot. Not to be used for defending classified military installations. Make sure the APU is running - the probe core consumes a good deal of electricity.

name: bluedog_X15_DropTank
title: K-15 Wedgetail Drop Tank
description: Drop tanks for the K-15 Wedgetail.

name: bluedog_X15_DummyScramjet
title: K-15 Wedgetail Experimental Dummy Scramjet
description: Experimental Dummy Scramjet. Designed to test high-speed aerodynamics. Certinaly not a Cubic Octagonal Strut

name: bluedog_X15_Engine
title: K-15 Wedgetail Engine
description: Rocket engine for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. More variants are in development.

name: bluedog_X15_Fuselage
title: K-15 Wedgetail Fuselage
description: Fuselage for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. Includes multiple length variants.\n\nThe "vent" engine will dump fuel quite quickly when landed, but not use much fuel in flight, to allow for startup venting effects during airlaunch (vent toggles with action group 09 by default).

name: bluedog_X15_HeliumTank
title: K-15A-2 Wedgetail Helium Tank
description: Supplemental helium tank for the uprated K-15A-2. We don't have any use for helium, so we've decided to fill it with monopropellant instead. Attaches to the node on top of the K-15 engine.

name: bluedog_X15_Horizon
title: K-15 Wedgetail Horizon Definition Experiment
description: Science tailbox for the K-15 Wedgetail. This one includes an infrared experiment designed to measure horizon phenomena and their stability at reference points for navigation in space.

name: bluedog_X15_Nose
title: K-15 Wedgetail Nose
description: Nose for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. Provides advanced SAS modes as well as atmospheric readings.

name: bluedog_X15_NoseGear
title: K-15 Wedgetail Nose Gear
description: Nose landing gear for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. Also includes the forward RCS units for pitch and yaw control outside of the atmosphere.

name: bluedog_X15_Photometer
title: K-15 Wedgetail Photometer Experiment
description: Science tailbox for the K-15 Wedgetail. This one includes a photometer experiment to aid in the development of attitude sensing and control systems.

name: bluedog_X15_Pylon
title: K-15 Wedgetail Pylon
description: Dedicated pylon for attaching the K-15 Wedgetail to the carrier plane (Not included).

name: bluedog_X15_RearWing
title: K-15 Wedgetail Horizontal Stabilizer
description: Rear horizontal stabilizer for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. Must be attached one at a time, with the correct side selected.

name: bluedog_X15_SERJ_Engine
title: K-15 Wedgetail S.E.R.J. Engine
description: The Supercharged Ejector RamJet is a multi-mode combination air-breathing and closed cycle rocket engine for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. Be sure to include the air intake. Runs in high effecicency fan mode below Mach 1, automatically transitioning to ramjet mode at higher speeds. Rocket Augmented mode is used to boost past Mach 1.

name: bluedog_X15_SERJ_Intake
title: K-15 Wedgetail Air Intake
description: Air intake for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane, for use with the S.E.R.J. engine.

name: bluedog_X15_Skid
title: K-15 Wedgetail Landing Skid
description: Rear landing skid for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. Must be attached one at a time, with the correct side selected.

name: bluedog_X15_SpyCamera
title: K-15 Wedgetail Spy Camera
description: Science experiment for the K-15 Wedgetail cockpit payload bay.

name: bluedog_X15_StackAdapter
title: K-15 Wedgetail Stack Adapter
description: Sure a large carrier aircraft is a perfectly fine way to launch a K-15 Wedgetail, but what if you want more speed? This 1.25m decoupling adapter allows mounting the K-15 in-line on top of a rocket! Fits the standard KLR-99 engine variant.

name: bluedog_X15_StellarCamera
title: K-15 Wedgetail Stellar Camera Experiment
description: Science experiment for the K-15 Wedgetail cockpit payload bay. Designed to meaure UV luminocity of the sky while at high altitudes to avoid the effects of the atmosphere. Also takes pretty pictures. Non-transmitable results.

name: bluedog_X15_TwoSeater
title: K-15B Wedgetail Tandem Cockpit
description: Tandem cockpit for the K-15B Wedgetail experimental rocket plane.  The "skylight hatch" has been removed, and the space occupied by a second occupant. They don't have a lot of room, and they are taking up one of the main scientific bays, but we're sure you'll put them to work. Also includes RCS fuel, auxiliary power units, and pilot.

name: bluedog_X15_VentralFin
title: K-15 Wedgetail Recoverable Ventral Fin
description: Ventral vertical stabilizer for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. Would use an all-moving fin design, but this one seems to be stuck. Due to the lack of ground clearance, it must be jettisoned and recovered prior to landing. <#ef7b06> AUTHOR'S NOTE: RealChute is recommended to get full functionality out of this part.</color>

name: bluedog_X15_Wing
title: K-15 Wedgetail Wing
description: Main wing for the K-15 Wedgetail experimental rocket plane. Includes thrusters used for roll control outside of the atmosphere. Must be attached one at a time, with the correct side selected.

name: bluedog_X15_WingtipPod

description: Removable wingtip science pods for the K-15 Wedgetail rocket plane.

title: RFP-1.5 Flag  (1.875m)
description: A flag that can be applied to size 1.5 tanks and other parts with the same curvature to show pride in your mission. Or use a different mission flag, if you really want to go that way.

name: flagPartSize4
title: RFP-4 Flag  (5m)
description: A huge flag that can be applied to size 4 tanks and other parts with the same curvature to show pride in your mission. Or use a different mission flag, if you really want to go that way.

name: FanShroud_01
title: S-062 Fan Shroud
description: This aesthetically pleasing shroud is for a small ducted fan engine.\n\nHelps reduce the incidence of air crew incidents with them by over 5%!

name: FanShroud_02
title: S-12 Fan Shroud
description: This aesthetically pleasing shroud is for a medium ducted fan engine.\n\nHelps reduce the incidence of air crew incidents with them by over 5%!

name: FanShroud_03
title: S-25 Fan Shroud
description: This aesthetically pleasing shroud fits a large ducted fan blade.\n\nHelps reduce the incidence of air crew incidents with them by over 5%!

name: noseconeTiny
title: Tiny Nosecone
description: A tiny nosecap for important, but small applications.\n\nDo not let Jeb borrow it to use as a hat.

name: noseconeVS
title: Very Small Nosecone
description: A small nosecap for aerodynamic streamlining. Its primary use is for rotors.

name: DeployedCentralStation
title: Probodobodyne Experiment Control Station
description:
The Probodobodyne Experiment Control Station coordinates and controls both power and data from nearby deployed parts, and coordinates sending it back to Kerbin.

Be sure to use one, if you want to generate any useful data.

Can be left to gather data over long periods of time, as the loneliness circuits were disabled during testing. <color=orange>Needs a deployed power unit to operate.</color>

name: DeployedGoExOb
title: Go-ob ED Monitor
description:
"What would happen if you left some mystery goo sitting around in the weird radiation and/or atmosphere of some faraway planet?" is a thought that has occurred to nearly every Kerbal. And now, you can find out thanks to the intrepid engineers at FLOOYD.

Note: Please allow trained Scientists to deploy for best results.
Also Note: Please do not return to Kerbin. Ever! <color=orange>Needs a deployed power unit & central station to operate.</color>

name: DeployedIONExp
title: Ionographer PD-22
description:
Normally in the business of building things that emit tons of Ions, ISPE has instead turned their hands to this nifty little gadget that helps detect them. 

Was it because of their devotion to the expansion of our universe? Or does it have something to do with the special, free filters they built meant to help 'screen out erroneous signals from nearby ion-generating devices'.

Note: Please allow trained Scientists to deploy for best results. <color=orange>Needs a deployed power unit & central station to operate.</color>

name: DeployedRTG
title: Mini-NUK-PD Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator
description: While small this small radioisotope thermoelectric generator can still provide plenty of power to run deployed science experiments.\n\nCareful calibration should be considered. <color=orange>Needs a deployed central station to operate. Bring a trained engineer or this part will only produce enough power for one other unit.</color>

name: DeployedSatDish
title: Communotron Ground HG-48
description: The Communotron Ground HG-48 is an adapted version of Ionic Symphonic Protonic Electronics most popular space-based antenna. Designed to boost the signal of any ground-based communication devices to interplanetary ranges.\n\nNot designed to pirate movie channels from nearby satellites. <color=orange>Needs a deployed central station to operate.</color>

name: DeployedSeismicSensor
title: Grand Slam Passive Seismometer
description: This ground-deployed sensor contains very delicate, sophisticated accelerometers meant to detect and analyze the precisely calibrated seismic shock waves generated by smashing rocket parts at high speed into whatever planet or moon it happens to be sitting on.\n\nNote: Please allow trained Scientists to deploy for best results. <color=orange>Needs a deployed power unit & central station to operate.</color>

name: DeployedSolarPanel
title: OX-Stat-PD Photovoltaic Panel
description: The OX-Stat-PD Photovoltaic Panel can, when properly set up by trained engineers, power several ground-breaking science experiments at a time. Reduced power output caused by allowing Jebediah to just 'unfold the flippy bit' is not covered under the manufacturer's warranty. <color=orange>Needs a deployed central station to operate. Bring a trained engineer or this part will only produce enough power for one other unit.</color>

name: DeployedWeatherStn
title: PD-3 Weather Analyzer
description: This multi-function experiment gathers data on wind, pressure, temperature, and humidity to generate a picture of the planets climate model over time./n/nNote: Please allow trained Scientists to deploy for best results. <color=orange>Needs a deployed power unit & central station to operate.</color>

name: largeFanBlade
title: R-25 Ducted Fan Blade
description: This large ducted fan propeller can push a lot of air through a small space.

name: largeHeliBlade
title: Helicopter Blade S
description: Rockets aren't the only way to go up.  This large helicopter-style rotor can create lift whenever there's enough atmospheric pressure.

name: largePropeller
title: Propeller Blade Type S
description: This blade part can be used to convert lift into thrust if you spin it fast enough. The advanced user can even find this useful on other planets with an atmosphere.

name: mediumFanBlade
title: R-12 Ducted Fan Blade
description: This medium ducted fan propeller can push a lot of air through a small space.

name: mediumHeliBlade

name: mediumPropeller

description: This blade part can be used to convert lift into thrust if you spin it fast enough. The advanced user can even find this useful on other planets with an atmosphere.

name: smallFanBlade

description: This small ducted fan propeller can push a lot of air through a small space.

name: smallHeliBlade
title: Helicopter Blade Type A
description: Rockets aren't the only way to go up.  This small  helicopter-style rotor can create lift whenever there's enough atmospheric pressure.

name: smallPropeller
title: Propeller Blade Type A
description: This blade part can be used to convert lift into thrust if you spin it fast enough. The advanced user can even find this useful on other planets with an atmosphere.

name: RotorEngine_02
title: R121 Turboshaft Engine
description: This strong turbine engine consumes liquid fuel and outputs angular acceleration. Also emits a pleasently high pitched whine.

name: RotorEngine_03
title: R7000 Turboshaft Engine
description: This massive turbine engine consumes liquid fuel and angular acceleration. We'd say its the most powerful thing you can buy - but it's still not a rocket.

name: controller1000
title: KAL-1000 Controller
description: A first of its kind, this intelligent programmable controller can manage a number of parts across a vessel.\n\nIts not an entirely autonomous entity... yet...

name: hinge_01
title: G-11 Hinge
description: A medium size actuator for variety of uses.  Be creative!

name: hinge_01_s
title: G-00 Hinge
description: A small actuator that can be used for a variety of purposes.  Over 20% of those have something to do with rockets.

name: hinge_03
title: G-12L Alligator Hinge
description: A medium actuator.  Moving Parts Experts Group offers no warranty if you jury rig your own landing legs with them.  Our engineers were curious what a warranty is for anyway.

name: hinge_03_s
title: G-01L Alligator Hinge
description: A small actuator with a longer frame that can be used for a variety of purposes.  Despite its appearence, clamping Wehner's loose notes together is not an ideal choice.

name: hinge_04
title: G-32W Hinge
description: The largest hinge actuator available.	 Doubles as an EZ-fold picnic table.

name: piston_01
title: 3P6 Hydraulic Cylinder
description: A large piston.  Can double in length,but still has an inferiority complex toward to the telescoping variants.

name: piston_02
title: 1P2 Hydraulic Cylinder
description: A small piston.  Useful for many things, especially height-challenged Kerbals.

name: piston_03
title: 3PT Telescoping Hydraulic Cylinder
description: A large telescoping piston.  Capable of enoroums feets of stretchiness.  Rocket engines are still recommened for attempting to reach orbit, however.

name: piston_04
title: 1P4 Telescoping Hydraulic Cylinder
description: A small telescoping piston.  Eye protection is mandetory when working with this part.

name: rotoServo_00
title: Rotation Servo M-06
description: A small, high-torque servo that can rotate attached parts through almost 360 degrees.  No Kerbals were harmed in the creation of this part.  Yet.

name: rotoServo_02
title: Rotation Servo F-12
description: The flush mounted rotation servo has reduced output but a much sleeker form factor, hiding all the motor bits inside the servohead itself, reducing the space it requires.

name: rotoServo_03
title: Rotation Servo M-12
description: A medium, high-torque servo that can rotate attached parts through almost 360 degrees.  Makes sure any evil robots you construct with it can see behind themselves.

name: rotoServo_04
title: Rotation Servo M-25
description: A large, high-torque servo that can rotate attached parts through almost 360 degrees.	When you just don't have enough torque for whatever nefarious prupose you have in mind, this is what you use.

name: rotor_01
title: EM-16 Light Duty Rotor
description: A small low-torque, high RPM eletric motor

name: rotor_01s
title: EM-16S Light Duty Rotor
description: A small low-torque, high RPM electric motor.  The smaller attachment head allows for more power applied to a smaller space.  No warranty applies if you attempt to duplicate a blender with it.

name: rotor_02
title: EM-32 Standard Rotor
description: A medium low-torque, high RPM eletric motor

name: rotor_02s
title: EM-32S Standard Rotor
description: A medium low-torque, high RPM eletric motor.  The smaller attachment head allows for more power applied to a smaller space.

name: rotor_03
title: EM-64 Heavy Rotor
description: A large low-torque, high RPM eletric motor.  Make sure you don't run out of EC, or it will only be useful as a large lazy susan.

name: rotor_03s
title: EM-64S Heavy Rotor
description: A large low-torque, high RPM electric motor.  The smaller head allows it to masquearade as a medium rotor - don't be fooled!

name: RobotArmScanner_S1
title: CRSY Light Scanning Arm
description: The Experimental Engineering Group managed to successfully adapt technologies from several other manufacturers to produce this once-in-a-lifetime piece of technology.  The light scanning arm is capable of indepedant work on distant planets, analyzing the geogology and composition of rocks and other surface features with two different instruments.  A master piece of engineering and design.

name: RobotArmScanner_S2
title: SPRT Medium Scanning Arm
description: The Experimental Engineering Group has triumped in creating a larger version of their previous scanning arm, duplicating their heroic feat for a twice-in-a-lifetime scientific accomplishment. The medium scanning arm incoporates a 3rd instrument for further data gathering, increasing the amount of data the arm can gather.

name: RobotArmScanner_S3
title: OPPO Large Scanning Arm
description: The Experimental Engineering Group's marketting department claims this is another once in a lifetime achievement.  We're starting to get suspicious.  Nonetheless, this even larger rover arm has four separate instruments, and we can't think of what else they might add, so this is probably the top of the line model from them.

name: lGripPad
title: GP-156 Grip Pad
description: A large size non-slip pad so that you don't slip off the back of your mech-bot as you stomp across KSC in search of science! Comes in two form factors and three grip levels.

name: lGripStrip
title: GPS-156 Grip Strip
description: A large non-slip strip, giving unparalleled traction for all your non-slip needs.

name: mGripPad
title: GP-036 Grip Pad
description: A medium size non-slip pad so that the feet of your mecha-bot do not slip out from under it on the shifty sands of Duna. Comes in two form factors and three grip levels.

name: sGripPad
title: GP-004 Grip Pad
description: A very small non-slip pad to help make sure rocks do not slip out of the fingers of your mecha-bot. Comes in two form factors and three grip levels.

name: sGripStrip
title: GPS-025 Grip Strip
description: A non slip strip. The manufacturer assures us the price is justified and 'going down to the local market and buying a nice doormat' would NOT be just as good.

name: AdvancedCanard
title: Advanced Canard
description: Our engineers thought this design looked "high tech" and therefore must be clear improvement on earlier models.

name: CanardController
title: Standard Canard
description: Our engineers had a stroke of inspiration after "visiting" the Kerlington production facilities. Introducing our new controllable canards. Warning, hard maneuvering may cause unintended stage separation.

name: CircularIntake
title: Circular Intake
description: A proper turbofan intake, not only provides oxygen to air breathing engines, it pulls in twice as much air than those puny air scoops from Vac-Co. Optimized for subsonic flight.

name: HeatShield0
title: Heat Shield (0.625m)
description: A tiny structural heat shield

name: HeatShield1
title: Heat Shield (1.25m)
description: A small structural heat shield with an integrated fairing

name: HeatShield2
title: Heat Shield (2.5m)
description: A medium structural heat shield with an integrated fairing

name: HeatShield3
title: Heat Shield (3.75m)
description: A large structural heat shield with an integrated fairing

name: InflatableHeatShield
title: Heat Shield (10m)
description: Based on the design of a child's toy, this heat shield uses a set of inflatable rings covered with a thermal blanket to provide a generous 10 meter heat shield for reentry and deceleration, and the aerodynamic qualities of an untethered bouncy castle.

name: IntakeRadialLong
title: Adjustable Ramp Intake (Radial)
description: This intake addresses those sometimes absurd contraptions that SSTO engineers designed in an attempt to pump more and more air into their engines. Optimized for supersonic flight.

name: R8winglet
title: AV-R8 Winglet
manufacturer: Kerlington Model Rockets and Paper Products Inc
description: The R8 Active Control Winglet series marked the debut of Kerlington Model Rockets in the Spacecraft engineering world. These winglets are equipped with movable pivots, which allow them to swivel and act as control surfaces. This feature was considered a huge advancement in control technology and most agree that it made Kerlington staff and R8 fans simply unbearable to be around.

name: StandardCtrlSrf
title: Elevon 1
description: Made from the finest materials at hand, these flight surfaces are guaranteed to operate while attached to the craft. However studies have shown that a lack of atmosphere *may* slightly impede function. No refunds.

name: airScoop
title: XM-G50 Radial Air Intake
description: An intake duct version that can be mounted at the sides of a fuselage. Warranty does not cover engine flame-outs or any objects, inanimate or otherwise, sucked in by the intake. Optimized for subsonic flight.

name: airbrake1
title: A.I.R.B.R.A.K.E.S
description: Research into feasible ways to slow down a plane in mid-air showed that loose hull panels are pretty great as drag-inducing deceleration devices. The discovery led to the invention of the Aerodynamically Integrated Retrograde Braking Robustly Armed Kinetic Extending System (A.I.R.B.R.A.K.E.S.), which is now popular mostly as a cheap alternative to longer runways. C7 Engineers are still trying to come up with a shorter name for such a long acronym.

name: airlinerCtrlSrf
title: FAT-455 Aeroplane Control Surface
description: Large conventional control surface.

name: airlinerMainWing
title: FAT-455 Aeroplane Main Wing
description: One of the largest lifting surfaces in production. The internal volume of these is big enough to carry generously sized fuel tanks.

name: airlinerTailFin
title: FAT-455 Aeroplane Tail Fin
description: Large conventional wing with built-in control surface.

name: airplaneTail
title: Tail Connector A
description: A simple aerodynamic tail for aircraft. Designed to fit onto all standard 1.25m attachments, this part is the embodiment of our "Let's Fly", line of parts.

name: airplaneTailB
title: Tail Connector B
description: This raised variant of our popular airplane tail provides a lot of ground clearance during take-off.

name: avionicsNoseCone
title: CH-J3 Fly-By-Wire Avionics Hub
description: Have you ever wanted to impress your peers by showing off your elite flying skills, but lacked the skills to become a trained pilot? C7 Aerospace's Fly-By-Wire Avionics Hub is the solution! This module allows even the most minimally trained crew to fly like an Ace! WARNING: This module cannot operate autonomously. Warranty void if attempting to do so. WARNING: Module contains no internal gyroscopes or control systems (control actuators sold separately). WARNING: Warranty void without proper use of C7 Aerospace Brand Sickness Bags (sold separately, currently out of stock).

name: basicFin
title: Basic Fin
manufacturer: Jebediah Kerman's Junkyard and Spacecraft Parts Co
description: This simple bolt-on aluminum fin may not be the cutting edge of aerospace engineering but it's dirt cheap and will make your rocket slightly less unstable.

name: deltaWing
title: Delta Wing
description: Standard Delta configuration wings. These wings provide high lift and a stable center of gravity for your everyday lifting needs.

name: delta_small
title: Small Delta Wing
description: This small delta wing has breezed through extensive stress tests and design revisions, mostly because it wasn't involved in any of those. In any case, it should work as a comparatively reliable lifting surface.

name: elevon2
title: Elevon 2
description: Made from the finest materials at hand, these flight surfaces are guaranteed to operate while attached to the craft. However studies have shown that a lack of atmosphere *may* slightly impede function. No refunds.

name: elevon3
title: Elevon 3
description: Made from the finest materials at hand, these flight surfaces are guaranteed to operate while attached to the craft. However studies have shown that a lack of atmosphere *may* slightly impede function. No refunds.

name: elevon5
title: Elevon 5
description: Just another one of these elevon things... wait, this one is swept! Wow!

name: fairingSize1
title: AE-FF1 Airstream Protective Shell (1.25m)
description: While the Kerbals at Mission Control were still figuring out how to get their rockets back down to Kerbin safely, the research engineers at FLOOYD were quickly realising that protecting parts on ascent was just as important. Heavy research into two-dimensional-input driven procedural construction was then funded with the hopes of making protective shells for important payloads and interstage areas of the crafts. The protective shells also have the benefit of making the craft more aerodynamic, hopefully saving on precious rocket fuel! The AE-FF1 is the smallest size available from FLOOYD.

name: fairingSize2
title: AE-FF2 Airstream Protective Shell (2.5m)
description: While the Kerbals at Mission Control were still figuring out how to get their rockets back down to Kerbin safely, the research engineers at FLOOYD were quickly realising that protecting parts on ascent was just as important. Heavy research into two-dimensional-input driven procedural construction was then funded with the hopes of making protective shells for important payloads and interstage areas of the crafts. The protective shells also have the benefit of making the craft more aerodynamic, hopefully saving on precious rocket fuel! The AE-FF2 is the mid-range size available from FLOOYD.

name: fairingSize3
title: AE-FF3 Airstream Protective Shell (3.75m)
description: While the Kerbals at Mission Control were still figuring out how to get their rockets back down to Kerbin safely, the research engineers at FLOOYD were quickly realising that protecting parts on ascent was just as important. Heavy research into two-dimensional-input driven procedural construction was then funded with the hopes of making protective shells for important payloads and interstage areas of the crafts. The protective shells also have the benefit of making the craft more aerodynamic, hopefully saving on precious rocket fuel! The AE-FF3 is the largest size available from FLOOYD.

name: miniIntake
title: Small Circular Intake
description: A must-have for air breathing engines, this intake duct will pull in outside air to run turbine engines on, as long as there is any outside air to begin with, of course. Optimized for subsonic flight.

name: noseCone
title: Aerodynamic Nose Cone
description: Aerodynamic, lightweight and mostly non-explosive. As a reminder to all personnel operating nearby, this part is really sharp and it'd probably hurt if you fell on it.

name: noseConeAdapter
title: NCS Adapter
description: The base of C7 Aerospace's Nose Cone system (NCS)

name: pointyNoseConeA
title: Advanced Nose Cone - Type A
description: Less drag due to pointy shape.

name: pointyNoseConeB
title: Advanced Nose Cone - Type B
description: Useful for boosters - the slanted shape is good for leading pressure away from the core stages.

name: ramAirIntake
title: Adjustable Ramp Intake
description: At supersonic speeds, -PATENT PENDING, CLASSIFIED INFO- inside the intake duct deflect the incoming air stream, causing -PATENT PENDING, CLASSIFIED INFO-, which creates a -PATENT PENDING, CLASSIFIED INFO-, thereby greatly increasing the efficiency of this unit at supersonic speeds. Patents Pending.

name: rocketNoseConeSize3
title: Protective Rocket Nose Cone Mk12A
description: A huge nosecone to help make 3.75 rockets cut through the air.

name: rocketNoseCone_v2
title: Protective Rocket Nose Cone Mk7
description: A large nose cone for covering up exposed areas of big rockets.

name: rocketNoseCone_v3
title: Protective Rocket Nose Cone Mk7
description: A large nose cone for covering up exposed areas of big rockets.

name: shockConeIntake
title: Shock Cone Intake
description: A shocking new intake from the C7 Aerospace Division that brought you much adored parts such as the Delta Wing and the Standard Nosecone! Offers exceptional performance at all speeds and has some heat shielding of its own.

name: smallCtrlSrf
title: Elevon 4
description: Feel the need to attach an elevator, rudder or aileron to just about any surface you can get your mitts on? Well this small elevon is for you. Made of mostly new factory parts, it will fit just about anywhere. Just don't expect a huge performance out of such a small part.

name: standardNoseCone
title: Small Nose Cone
description: An aerodynamic nose cap.

name: structuralWing
title: Structural Wing Type A
description: This wing has been constructed out of surplus wing components. Comes complete with "like new" finish. Intended uses include very large canards, and leading edges of larger delta wings.

name: structuralWing2
title: Structural Wing Type B
description: This wing has been constructed out of surplus wing components. Comes complete with "like new" finish.

name: structuralWing3
title: Structural Wing Type C
description: This wing has been constructed out of surplus wing components. Comes complete with "like new" finish.

name: structuralWing4
title: Structural Wing Type D
description: This wing has been constructed out of surplus wing components. Comes complete with "like new" finish.

name: sweptWing
title: Swept Wings
description: A prototype swept back wing, part of our "Let's Fly", line. Made of light weight composite materials. Guaranteed to generate lift, not guaranteed to ensure crew safety.

name: sweptWing1
title: Swept Wing Type A
description: This wing has been constructed out of surplus wing components. Comes complete with "like new" finish.

name: sweptWing2
title: Swept Wing Type B
description: This wing has been constructed from surplus wing components. Comes complete with "like new" finish.

name: tailfin
title: Tail Fin
description: This tailfin has passed extensive modeling in our patented P.A.S system.(Paper Airplane Simulation). This fin has been blunted to prevent accidental dismemberment of installing technicians.

name: wingConnector
title: Wing Connector Type A
description: A vaguely wing shaped board. Use at your own risk.

name: wingConnector2
title: Wing Connector Type B
description: A vaguely wing shaped board. Use at your own risk.

name: wingConnector3
title: Wing Connector Type C
description: A vaguely wing shaped board.

name: wingConnector4
title: Wing Connector Type D
description: Found in a trash bin next to a wing factory.

name: wingConnector5
title: Wing Connector Type E
description: Found in a trash bin next to a wing factory.

name: wingShuttleDelta
title: Big-S Delta Wing
description: The Big-S line of wings are C7's largest lifting surfaces to date. Not only are they Sturdy and heat resistant enough to survive reentry, but also have enough internal volume to carry optional fuel tanks.

name: wingShuttleElevon1
title: Big-S Elevon 1
description: The Big-S line of wings are C7's largest lifting surfaces to date. Not only are they Sturdy and heat resistant enough to survive reentry, but also have enough internal volume to carry optional fuel tanks.

name: wingShuttleElevon2
title: Big-S Elevon 2
description: The Big-S line of wings are C7's largest lifting surfaces to date. Not only are they Sturdy and heat resistant enough to survive reentry, but also have enough internal volume to carry optional fuel tanks.

name: wingShuttleRudder
title: Big-S Spaceplane Tail Fin
description: Large heat resistant spaceplane fin.

name: wingShuttleStrake
title: Big-S Wing Strake
description: The Big-S line of wings are C7's largest lifting surfaces to date. Not only are they Sturdy and heat resistant enough to survive reentry, but also have enough internal volume to carry optional fuel tanks.

name: wingStrake
title: Wing Strake
description: Strakes are like sideburns for your plane. The girls will fall for you!

name: winglet
title: AV-T1 Winglet
description: Nothing is really known about this thing. Use it at your own risk.

name: winglet3
title: Delta-Deluxe Winglet
manufacturer: Kerlington Model Rockets and Paper Products Inc
description: The Delta-Deluxe Winglet is a large aerodynamic surface with a small built-in aileron. It is very lightweight and offers more lift than the AV-R8 but the small control surface area means it is not as quick to turn.

name: CargoStorageUnit
title: SEQ-24 Cargo Storage Unit
description: When you want to bring everything and the kitchen sink, this is the storage unit for you. Capable of transporting 24 different cargo items, or a small houses worth of goods and furniture. Colonize Duna in style!

name: ConformalStorageUnit
title: SEQ-3C Conformal Storage Unit
description: A small storage container, built with conformal aerodynamics in mind to allow its use on both aircraft and spacecraft. Perfect for small cargo needs, or a secret snack supply.

name: cargoContainer
title: SEQ-9 Container Module
description: A large 1.25 container, capable of storing a wide variety of equipment but specifically designed for storing precision scientific instruments and protecting them from the rigours of launch, travel, and landing on distance planets Warning: Contents not pressurized. Risk of Snack Bag explosion >99%.

name: evaChute
title: Personal Parachute
manufacturer: Found lying by the side of the road
description: This Kerbal-sized ram-air parachute is perfect for saving intrepid pilots from a mis-considered aircraft design, or hijinks involving the top of the VAB and a hopeffuly functional autopilot.   Why should Kerbals put their trust in something that was found lying by the side of the road?   Well, because there wasn't a Kerbal-shaped crater next to it!

name: evaCylinder
title: EVA Fuel Cylinders
description: When you just don't have enough delta-V to visit all your favorite spots on Minimus, or want to circumnavigate Dres freestyle, you'll want to pack this spare EVA fuel cylinder for extra-long duration EVA trips.\n\nHandily tranfers fuel to your EVA jetpack with a child-proof safety seal.

name: evaJetpack
title: EVA Jetpack
description: The EVA jetpack has been a workhorse of kerbal astronauts for decades. It has been so useful that some kerbals have taken to wearing them inside the complex, back home, and even in their showers.\n\nIt gives unparalleled mobility in space and low gravity environments but can be tricky to master. Incidences of injury while using one have dropped to nearly 10% after sufficient training.

name: evaRepairKit
title: EVA Repair Kit
description: This repair kit has some generic widgets, tape, tools, and other knicknacks to allow intrepid Kerbals to effect repairs on broken parts that may have suffered unplanned dissassembly.  Note: Repair kits will be used up effecting repairs, and more than one repair kit may be required for especially large parts.

name: evaScienceKit
title: EVA Experiments Kit
description: Probodobodyne has meticulously curated and assembled this case full of various devices and knicknacks, all of which are useful for science experiments.  Despite observations to the contrary, we feel that the inability for Kerbal astronauts to find a good use for the collapsible top hat and magic wand to be more of an issue with lack of creativity, rather than a case of items being left inside from a prior use case.

name: groundAnchor
title: Stamp-O-Tron Ground Anchor
description: Occaisionally, even the most seasoned of rocket jockeys wants to be safely back on the ground - and what better way to securely show your affection for gravity than by clamping yourself to it?   The Stamp-O-Tron ground anchor provides a secure point to which you can attach other parts with EVA construction, including docking ports if you'd like to park a larger vessel safely.  Expect stocks in C7 Aerospace Division to jump if negative gravity is ever a real thing.

name: smallCargoContainer
title: SEQ-3 Cargo Storage Unit
description: This sturdy unit keeps the expensive and delicate equipment our astronauts need to bring with them safely stored.  Rigorous engineering studies have shown it to be 20% more effective than 'a picnic cooler and some duct tape' at making sure these items arrive intact at their destination.

name: MK1CrewCabin
title: Mk1 Crew Cabin
description: A cozy passenger cabin derived from a business jet and upgraded for use in spacecraft.

name: Mark1Cockpit
title: Mk1 Cockpit
description: C7 Aerospace is proud to present our second generation cockpit. This unit is equipped to ensure survival in some of the worst conditions possible. The extra re-enforcement has slightly increased the weight.

name: Mark2Cockpit
title: Mk1 Inline Cockpit
description: A next generation inline cockpit. Designed for sleek high speed aircraft.

name: MpoProbe
title: MPO Probe
description: The Moho Planetary Observer combines the function of many parts in one, to help make sure the searing heat of its primary mission target is distributed and dissipated without harming its critical control functionality.

name: MtmStage
title: MTM Stage
description: The Moho Transfer Module houses a control core and a generously sized xenon tank. Perfect for transporting large scientific payloads anywhere where large amounts of deltaV are required.

name: advSasModule
title: Advanced Inline Stabilizer
